decisions.selected: Treat creation of a valid changeset file on the labeled pull request as the operational outcome.
alternatives: Use changeset content quality as the primary outcome.
decisions.rationale: The workflow mission and task explicitly require creating a properly formatted changeset; content accuracy is a separate workflow evaluation.

decisions.selected: One pull request activated by the changeset or smoke label.
alternatives: Treat every workflow run, including workflow_dispatch, as an opportunity.
decisions.rationale: The trigger and activation condition are label-based; manual runs do not identify the intended pull-request opportunity.

decisions.selected: Bind to pull-request number, recovering it from the historical workflow run when case and event are null.
alternatives: Bind only from the event payload.
decisions.rationale: The run API retains pull-request associations, allowing historical replay without relying on a supplied case or event.

decisions.selected: A new non-README .changeset markdown file with valid frontmatter and non-empty body at the cutoff commit.
alternatives: Use agent traces or safe-output activity.
decisions.rationale: The repository format specifies the accepted file structure, while file content and Git history directly demonstrate the repository outcome.

decisions.selected: One day after run creation, capped at the earlier evidence time.
alternatives: Use a permanently open evidence window.
decisions.rationale: Safe output commits can arrive after the agent run; a fixed one-day horizon permits delivery while making mature observations stable.

decisions.selected: Binary direct attainment: 1 for at least one new valid changeset, otherwise 0; unavailable evidence is null.
alternatives: Use activity or output counts as the primary value.
decisions.rationale: The operational target is satisfied by the existence of a valid changeset, and no defensible partial attainment scale is specified.

alternatives: Use pre-adoption changeset prevalence as a comparable baseline.
decisions.rationale: The workflow was adopted in commit 06d7770; pre-adoption repository changesets are not observations of this labeled automation and cannot establish a comparable workflow baseline.

decisions.selected: Report the count of new valid changeset files separately.
alternatives: Combine file count with attainment in the primary value.
decisions.rationale: Multiple files provide context but do not represent greater completion of the single requested changeset outcome.

uncertainties.description: GitHub workflow-run pull_requests association may be unavailable for some historical or manually replayed runs.
Pull-request commit or contents API responses may be unavailable or truncated during replay.
A changeset may be committed after the one-day maturation horizon.
